title: Roadmap editing: reorder an item from the TUI (needs adj 11)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Reordering a queue item from the TUI uses `slicer move ID` with a position flag: before, after or to (../slicer/docs/commands.md:32). The position is the manual priority. It waits on adj 11 as S67 does. It also needs the Roadmap screen (S12): internal/tui/roadmap.go does not exist, and the view bar shows Roadmap as not selectable (internal/tui/view.go:167-171).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- internal/tui/roadmap.go and roadmap_test.go (new; from S12).
- internal/slicercli/write.go (new Move wrapper; `slicer move` keeps a move inside one kind, commands.md:512).
- internal/daemon/handlers.go (new write method, beside S67's).
- internal/tui/keys.go and model.go (confirm bar as in S67).
- docs/dashboard.md:219-223 (Roadmap section).
- testdata/golden/ (new roadmap goldens; go test ./internal/tui -update, then review).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestMoveShowsExactCommandOnConfirm: the bar shows `slicer move ID --before OTHER` (or --after).
- TestMoveAcrossKindsShowsSlicerError: slicer refuses; the TUI shows the error and does not guess.
- TestMoveReloadsQueueInSlicerOrder.
- TestMoveInPlaceIsNoOp.
